report:
This PR is ready to merge: I found nothing the contributor has to fix.

**Checks:**
- **Tests:** `pnpm vitest run packages/tailwindcss` passes: 42 test files, 5017 passed, 1 skipped.
- **Prettier:** `npx prettier --check` on `CHANGELOG.md`, `utilities.ts`, `utilities.test.ts` and `property-order.ts` reports "All matched files use Prettier code style!".
- **Type check:** `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/tailwindcss` shows errors, but they all come from `@tailwindcss/oxide` not being built (in `candidate.bench.ts`, `index.bench.ts`, `ui.spec.ts` and the webpack package). None are in the files this PR changes.
- **Leftover files:** there are none, and `git status` is back to exactly the five modified files I started with.

**Behaviour checked against the issue:**
- **Named and keyword forms:** `anchor-tooltip` gives `anchor-name: --tooltip`, `anchor-none` gives `none`, `anchored-menu` gives `position-anchor: --menu`, and `anchored-auto` gives `auto`.
- **Arbitrary values:** `anchor-[--a,--b]`, `anchored-[--menu]` and `anchor-(--x)` (which becomes `var(--x)`) all pass through.
- **Forms that must produce nothing:** bare `anchor`/`anchored`, negative forms, and modifiers (including `anchor-(--x)/50`, which I added as a probe) all produce empty output.
- **IntelliSense:** the class-list snapshot gains exactly `anchor-none` and `anchored-auto`.
- **Variants and important:** `hover:anchor-a` and `anchored-auto!` behave as expected.
- **Conventions:** the utilities sit in `utilities.ts` with `@css` doc comments, like the neighbouring utilities. Both test blocks cover valid and invalid candidates, and there is an Unreleased → Added entry in the changelog.

**Things worth mentioning but not blocking:**
- The changelog entry has no PR link. Every other entry in that file has one, e.g. `([#20100](https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss/pull/20100))` at line 83.
- `property-order.ts` was changed to place `anchor-name` and `position-anchor` after `position`. The issue doesn't ask for this, but it's a reasonable way to keep class sorting sensible.
- Bare values that look like CSS keywords become dashed idents, since the issue only reserves `none` and `auto` respectively: `anchor-inherit` gives `--inherit` and `anchored-none` gives `--none`. Similarly, `anchor--foo` gives `---foo`. These follow from the issue's rule, but the last one might deserve a guard.
